title: NoSwiftnessFOV
description: A lightweight, client-side mod that completely removes the swiftness FOV effect. Keeps your field of view perfectly locked and your aim consistent when gaining speed—zero bloat, PvP optimized.
body:
# No Swiftness FOV *Completely removes the annoying FOV widening caused by speed effects.*
[![Platform: Fabric](https://img.shields.io/badge/Platform-Fabric-5c6370?style=for-the-badge&logo=fabric)](https://modrinth.com) [![Minecraft: 1.21.x - 1.21.11](https://img.shields.io/badge/Minecraft-1.21.x%20--%201.21.11-4a7227?style=for-the-badge)](https://modrinth.com)
--- **No Swiftness FOV** is a lightweight, client-side modification that entirely stops Minecraft from changing your Field of View when you gain a speed boost. Whether you drink a Speed potion, trigger a beacon effect, or get any swiftness modifier, your screen stays perfectly locked at your base setting.
### ✨ Features * **Zero FOV Distortion** Eliminates the aggressive "zoom-out" fish-eye effect whenever speed modifiers are active. * **PvP & Aim Optimized** Keeps your muscle memory intact by maintaining a consistent field of view during fast-paced combat. * **Lightweight & Clean** No unnecessary bloat, configuration menus, or performance overhead. * **Client-Side Only** Runs entirely on your end. Connect to any server without needing it installed on the host.
### ⚙️ Compatibility & Versions * **Mod Loader:** Built exclusively for **Fabric**. * **Supported Versions:** Fully supports **Minecraft 1.21.x** all the way up to **1.21.11**. * Compatible with major performance modpacks (like *Fabulously Optimized*) and camera mods.
### 🚀 Installation 1. Make sure you have the **Fabric Loader** installed for your desired 1.21 version. 2. Drop this mod's `.jar` file into your Minecraft `.minecraft/mods` folder. 3. Launch the game and enjoy smooth, unaltered FOV!!
